                             Resolution 2024-02
                 Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors

                      RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT
                          FOR
         SEVEN-DAY MOA TRAFFIC SPEED AND VOLUME STUDY

WHEREAS, Girdwood is a pedestrian-friendly community in which many adults and children access neighborhood
amenities on foot regardless of weather, daylight, and road conditions; and

WHEREAS, Girdwood’s streets offer a variety of challenges to drivers and pedestrians, including foliage and
snowbanks, steep slopes and generally narrow roadbeds without sidewalks, and

WHEREAS, a traffic study on Timberline Drive conducted in 2023 documented traffic of 2552 daily trips;

WHEREAS, Alyeska Resort is purposing a three-phase development of the Hotel area that will increase traffic on
Arlberg;

THEREFORE, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors requests that the MOA Traffic Department conduct a seven-day
Speed and Volume study on the following roads during the summer season in 2024:
    x   Timberline Drive between Alyeska Highway and Vail intersections
    x   Arlberg Road at Moose Meadows Park


PASSED AND APPROVED by a vote of 5 to 0 this 15th day of April, 2024.



Guy Wade
GBOS Parks and Recreation Supervisor              Attest
